answer: Depletion-scaled creation levy. Each new identity draws from a shared grove of registration permits; the nth permit in a window costs base × 2^(n/50). The levy is paid in a scarce pigment token consumed on issuance, so mass registration drains supply. An attacker minting 10,000 identities pays roughly 200× the marginal rate near the end, while honest users each pay near base. Timber reserves cap throughput per epoch regardless of spend.
